sam (AE): Heads up team — Pinewave wants a short POC to validate performance and cost before signing. Workload is conv+retrieval: 70% chat generation (avg 256 tokens), 30% chunk embedding. Target: sustained 500 qps, 3x 45s spikes to 3k qps, goal p95 gen <=200ms. They want KMS + VPC peering. Can we sketch a run plan + rough monthly cost?
viv (Solutions Eng): Yep. Need to pin model choices (13b vs 70b), embedding dim, and typical prompt templating. Also confirm whether retrieval is batched client-side.
drew (SRE): From infra side, VPC peering adds NAT hops depending on their setup; expect ~6-10ms added on network e2e. KMS adds ~7ms on cold key loads. Warmup avoids most of that.
sam (AE): They prefer rwd-13b-q4 for cost but want quality check vs rwd-70b-q4 for fallback. Embedding is 1536-dim, batched server-side where possible.
viv (Solutions Eng): Proposed test plan:
- 20m smoke (sanity)
- 45m ramp to 500 qps + 1h steady at 500 qps
- 3 spikes: 45s @3000 qps spaced 4m apart
- gen max_tokens=256, beam=1; embed batch_size=32
I'll run two passes: primary on 13B, fallback on 70B (same harness).
anya (Product): Add quality evals: 200-sample side-by-side transcript scoring, and a retrieval-precision metric for embeddings. We'll attach short notes.
viv (Solutions Eng): Running harness now. Command: 
```
rbench run --scenario conv-retrieval --gen-model rwd-13b-q4 --embed-model rwd-embed-1536 --qps 500 --burst 3000 --dur 7200 --batch-embed 32 --max-tokens 256 --warmup 120
```
(deploy-bot): Started job: bench-3050001234-pinewave (trace: TB-9012). Artifacts -> https://redwood.internal/bench/3050001234
drew (SRE): Reminder: enable continuous KV cache and increase cache TTL to avoid on-path misses during spikes. Also set batching window to 20ms for gen.
viv (Solutions Eng): First pass 13B results (steady 500 qps): gen median=98ms, p95=215ms, p99=420ms. Embeds median=18ms. During spikes p95 jumped to 560ms (queueing + cold-catalog effects).
sam (AE): p95 215ms slightly above 200ms goal. What levers?
viv (Solutions Eng): Two quick fixes we tried: 1) bump batching window -> median up ~6ms but p95 down to 185ms; 2) pre-warm model and KV to eliminate catalog misses -> spike p95 improved to ~240ms. Combined (bumping and optimized caching) produced: median=110ms, p95=180ms, p99=320ms.
anya (Product): Nice. Can we capture a routing policy suggestion so default stays 13B and fails over to 70B only when quality score falls below threshold? Provide config snippet.
viv (Solutions Eng): Canary routing snippet: 
```
{
  "route_type": "latency_then_quality",
  "latency_threshold_ms": 200,
  "quality_threshold": 0.82,
  "primary": "rwd-13b-q4",
  "fallback": "rwd-70b-q4"
}
```
drew (SRE): KMS + VPC measured overhead: ~12ms median added to gen path in our env. Recommend adding a 2-minute warmup during cutover. No infra compliance blockers; will prepare network diagram for their security team.
sam (AE): Cost ask: Pinewave wants monthly estimate for 150M tokens gen + 10M embeds, with 4x potential spike events per month.
viv (Solutions Eng): Quick hosted estimate (ballpark):
- Gen compute for 150M tokens on 13B: ~$27,000/mo
- Embeddings 10M @1536: ~$2,400/mo
- Burst buffer & reserved capacity: $6,500/mo
- KMS + networking premium: $1,000/mo
Total ~ $37k/mo. If they choose fallback to 70B for some queries, add ~+$10k/mo depending on route mix. I'll drop detailed sheet in prospect folder.
sam (AE): Perfect. Need a 1-slide summary and the spreadsheet by EOD. Also attach bench artifacts and the quality eval.
viv (Solutions Eng): Uploaded: https://redwood.internal/assets/pinewave/bench_artifacts_3050001234.zip (results, histograms, spreadsheet, runbook).
anya (Product): I'll add the 200-sample quality notes and a brief paragraph on expected delta between 13B and 70B for their conversational domain.
drew (SRE): I'll prepare the VPC diagram + a short FAQ for their security team (ISO controls pointer + key-flow).
sam (AE): Scheduling demo for Tue 11am PT. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
viv (Solutions Eng): One more note: include suggested client-side retry/backoff for 5xx during spikes. Small snippet goes into the runbook.
(deploy-bot): Job bench-3050001234-pinewave completed. Latency PNGs + CSVs at https://redwood.internal/bench/3050001234/results.zip
sam (AE): Marking as active. Will share slide with execs after reviews.
